question: Can a source-reliability-gated, finite-window prequential log-likelihood change detector reactivate stored source A under A-B-A shifts, reject false switches on independent noise/stationary controls, and beat/equal matched-evidence rolling MAP and Bayesian-hazard models?

hypotheses.mechanistic: A held-source predictive-reliability check and prequential log-evidence accumulation enable a bounded causal-graph mode switch without using hidden phase labels.
hypotheses.null: Any apparent return benefit is explainable by a source-memory predictor or conventional rolling/Bayesian mixing, and false switches cannot be simultaneously controlled with B adaptation.
hypotheses.prediction: A64 source reliability LOO Brier <=0.20 gate, then rolling 16-event log Bayes-ratio score threshold +/-3.0 with recent-32 alternate subset will reduce noise false switches to <=20% and improve return prediction vs rolling MAP without B adaptation regression.

changed_paths: existing G29 dual-OS replay workflow and derived G29 source atlas only

frozen_design.split: A64 unique 6-bit actions, B48 train +16 held distinct within phase, A-return48 train +16 held distinct within phase; independent seeded splits and visit/domain separated label noise. Stationary/noise cohorts keep truth relation stationary or independent fair. A/B true parents/functions hidden.
frozen_design.action_information: All policies get exactly source A64 then the same 96 online labeled feedback events. Held B/return actions are excluded from their phase's training. Their source A action IDs may overlap; treat this as action-vector rather than unseen-parent-pattern test.
frozen_design.protocol: Training sequences A-B-A but phases never named or observed by learner; score stream prequential predictions before each label, and each phase's 16 held-label vectors only after its 48 training labels.
frozen_design.budget: 384 persisted bytes: A64 (128 bytes), B+R up to96 (192 bytes), source/active masks and mode/counters in 64 metadata bytes. No external models or paid APIs.
frozen_design.native_scope: development-only synthetic finite Boolean worlds; no native Yggdrasil original first-use, production controller or Amalgam checkpoint mutation

mechanisms.source: Choose best <=3-parent mask over A64 by LOO Brier with penalty 0.003*2^k, tie ascending mask. Compute source model LOO Brier *without* complexity penalty for reliability check, threshold <=0.20. If not reliable, issue p=0.5 null and disable mode transitions; do not use true family labels.
mechanisms.alternate: Every 8 B/R streaming consequences, globally refit <=3-parent subset mask using only most recent <=32 known stream labels; use a separately implemented global exhaustive source predictor and rolling MAP, with identical mask universe and fit cadence. Both use same rolling MAP forecast model; conditional Laplace probabilities clipped to [.05,.95].
mechanisms.evidence: At each training label, calculate clipped prequential probability p_alt from rolling subset (from previous events only) and p_source from immutable A. Log-likelihood increment log(q(y)/pA(y)), append to FIFO window max16. No hidden boundary labels, no fit on held outcomes.
mechanisms.transitions: if source reliable and last16 log-likelihood increments sum >=3.0, enter alternate mode and set active mask from latest rolling MAP. If in alternate and sum <=-3.0, reactivate immutable source A. No phase-dependent reset. Every 8 events refresh alternative and allow activation only when at least 8 prior feedback events exist.
mechanisms.cooldown: One 8-event block after mode switch blocks additional mode switch; evidence window still updated.
controls: rolling static MAP refit every 8 observations (same mask search cadence as detector)
Bayesian hazard mixture of immutable A and rolling 32 subset posterior, hazard 1/64, update weights prequentially
phase-aware oracle only as informationally advantaged reference
mechanisms.candidate_work: Count 41 mask evaluations per panel and likelihood-evidence operations per observation for detector and controls; rolling MAP shares identical panel search and evidence with detector, source check is added overhead. Report operation/work and no equal FLOP/energy gain claims.
mechanisms.persistence: Serialize A64, up to 96 stream rows, source mask, active mask, mode, cooldown and <=16 evidence log increments quantized to signed fixed-point int16 in 384-byte state. Restore at B48 and mid-return72, require identical future predictions/state; no process-exit or native checkpoint claim.

metrics.primary: phase-end B and return held Brier with paired normal 95% CI over 128 related seeds; report 96-step prequential phase B/R Brier separately
metrics.secondary: fraction returning to source by R48, false switches on stationary/noise, true detection delays, paired Bayes/rolling losses, source preservation and exact cold restore
metrics.limitations: Even a positive all-threshold result is bounded synthetic development; independent actual native science is separate.

classification_rules.scientific_pass: All thresholds pass together; still only synthetic development candidate, not independently reproduced scientific gain.
classification_rules.scientific_no_go: Any threshold fails; preserve negative and all consumed seeds.
classification_rules.invalid: Unfrozen thresholds, missing chronological Git custody, phase label to learner, unreported comparator/data/compute imbalance, held outcome leakage or source-mismatch.

prohibited_after_primary_run: reusing these seeds as fresh primary trials
silently changing capacity or training access
